premise: Pachycephalosaurus jumps into the mud puddle — SPLOSH — and little Psittacosaurus won't come in, he doesn't want to get muddy, until a mud bubble goes blup and he laughs so much he slips right in; then the rain comes and washes them both clean.
inspiration: The nursery rhyme of Doctor Foster and his puddle, turned joyful: the puddle is the fun, the rain is the bath.
lesson: A little mess can be a lot of fun.

en-US.title: Splash in the Mud
en-US.text: {puddle:enter} [excited] {pachycephalosaurus:enter} Pachycephalosaurus spotted it first: a big, brown, squishy mud puddle. {pachycephalosaurus:go to puddle} "Here I come!" {pachycephalosaurus:live jump} He jumped right in. {puddle:live splash} {sfx:splosh} SPLOSH! Mud everywhere. {pachycephalosaurus:face happy} "It's warm! It's squishy!" {psittacosaurus:enter} {psittacosaurus:go to puddle} Little Psittacosaurus stopped at the edge. {psittacosaurus:shake} [nervously] "No, thank you. I don't want to get muddy." "Oh, come on!" {psittacosaurus:wobble} Psittacosaurus shook his head. Then… {puddle:live bubble} {sfx:blup} BLUP! A big mud bubble swelled up and popped, right between Pachycephalosaurus's feet. {pachycephalosaurus:face surprised} {pachycephalosaurus:hop} "Who said that?" Psittacosaurus {psittacosaurus:live laugh} laughed and laughed. He laughed so hard he wobbled, and slipped… {psittacosaurus:go on puddle} and SPLAT! {puddle:live splash} In he went. {psittacosaurus:face surprised} [laughs] Now they were both muddy from nose to tail. {psittacosaurus:face happy} And then, {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} pitter-patter, down came the rain, and washed them both clean. {all:face happy} [happily] "First a mud bath," said Pachycephalosaurus, "then a rain bath!" {psittacosaurus:hop x2} {canvas:rain stop}

es-ES.title: Chof en el barro
es-ES.text: {puddle:enter} [excited] {pachycephalosaurus:enter} Paquicefalosaurio lo vio el primero: un charco de barro grande, marrón y blandito. {pachycephalosaurus:go to puddle} —¡Allá voy! {pachycephalosaurus:live jump} Y saltó dentro. {puddle:live splash} {sfx:splosh} ¡CHOF! Barro por todas partes. {pachycephalosaurus:face happy} —¡Está calentito! ¡Y blandito! {psittacosaurus:enter} {psittacosaurus:go to puddle} El pequeño Psitacosaurio se paró en el borde. {psittacosaurus:shake} [nervously] —No, gracias. No quiero mancharme. —¡Anda, ven! {psittacosaurus:wobble} Psitacosaurio dijo que no con la cabeza. Y entonces… {puddle:live bubble} {sfx:blup} ¡BLUP! Una burbuja de barro enorme creció y explotó, justo entre las patas de Paquicefalosaurio. {pachycephalosaurus:face surprised} {pachycephalosaurus:hop} —¿Quién ha dicho eso? Psitacosaurio {psittacosaurus:live laugh} se rio y se rio. Se rio tanto que se tambaleó, resbaló… {psittacosaurus:go on puddle} y ¡PLAF! {puddle:live splash} Adentro. {psittacosaurus:face surprised} [laughs] Ahora estaban los dos llenos de barro del hocico a la cola. {psittacosaurus:face happy} Y entonces, {canvas:rain 0.7} {sfx:rain} plic, ploc, empezó a llover, y la lluvia los dejó limpios a los dos. {all:face happy} [happily] —¡Primero, baño de barro —dijo Paquicefalosaurio—, y luego, baño de lluvia! {psittacosaurus:hop x2} {canvas:rain stop}

splosh.prompt: a big squelchy splash as something jumps into a shallow mud puddle, comic and wet

blup.prompt: a single thick mud bubble swelling and popping, blup, squelchy and comic, close up

rain.prompt: light warm rain falling on a grassy meadow, gentle, realistic field recording
